title: release-evidence/v0 release event
description: DRAFT. One transition of D5's deployment state machine, one line of an append-only release-events.jsonl. Current state is always derived by folding; no event stores a computed state; nothing rewrites a past line. THE FOLD UNIT IS AN ATTEMPT: (release_id, bundle_digest). D5's own words -- a changed tree means prepare starts over -- make the re-prepared bundle a NEW attempt of the same release_id, so the same-digest invariant and the transition graph both apply per attempt, never across attempts (sol architect review 2026-08-22, must-4/ask-1). The transition graph itself is enforced by collection-level checks in verify-fixtures.mjs and by implementations; a single-record schema cannot see order.

event_id.description: Unique within the ledger (collection-checked). Implementations SHOULD derive it deterministically from (release_id, bundle_digest, kind, environment, occurred_at) so a re-emitted event is idempotent rather than duplicated.

kind.description: prepared = the evidence bundle was assembled and sealed (no environment yet). deployed/verified = the bundle's artifacts reached / were verified in `environment`. failed = a deploy attempt, a verification, or post-verification operation failed there (failure_phase says which). rolled_back = this attempt was withdrawn in favor of rollback_to_release_id. attested = a later-arriving piece of evidence (e.g. the lane's Phase-5 done overlay, which cannot exist at seal time for a pre-merge preview) was pinned WITHOUT changing the sealed bundle -- the state-machine position is unchanged by an attested event.

environment.description: null exactly when kind is prepared or attested (both are environment-less); every other kind names where it happened. Schema-enforced below.

occurred_at.description: UTC, literal Z only -- same rule as release-observation/v0's deployed_at, so deriving an observation event never needs timezone normalization (sol should-4).

actor.description: Who caused the transition. No `agent` member on purpose: v0 has no autonomous deploy path (D5 defers automatic promotion/rollback outright).

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical bytes of this attempt's sealed evidence bundle. Verified against the REAL bundle in release-collection fixtures -- a string that merely repeats across events proves nothing (sol must-2). Every event of one attempt MUST carry the same value; a new bundle is a new attempt starting at prepared.

failure_phase.description: failed only (schema-enforced below): deploy = the deploy attempt itself failed (legal directly from a pre-deploy state); verification = the environment's verification failed after a successful deploy; post_verification = a previously verified release was later observed broken (e.g. production incident). Required so release-observation/v0's verification_status can be machine-derived (sol must-6/ask-4).

rollback_to_release_id.description: rolled_back only (schema-enforced below): must resolve, within the same ledger, to a DIFFERENT release whose own attempt actually reached production (collection check; sol must-8).

reason.description: failed and rolled_back (schema-enforced below): what failed / why it was withdrawn, human-readable. Required on rolled_back too so a rollback never erases its own cause (sol must-7).

staging_skipped.description: deployed|production only, and only when the attempt went preview_verified -> production directly: D5 says staging skipping is policy-allowed but the FACT of skipping must be recorded on the event. Collection-checked both ways: required when the fold shows a direct jump, forbidden otherwise.

attestation.description: attested only (schema-enforced below). The seal-time/later-evidence split sol's must-3 requires: the bundle stays immutable from `prepared` on, and evidence that can only exist later (a merged lane's done overlay) arrives as an attestation pinned to the same bundle_digest. The production gate for a lane-backed bundle is: a lane_done_overlay attestation exists before deployed|production (collection-checked).

preview_skipped.description: deployed|production only, and only on a prepared -> production jump (no preview tier exists for this deploy target -- the case the FIRST real adapter exercise surfaced: a scheduled Pages rebuild has no preview environment at all). Mirrors staging_skipped: the skip is a recorded fact, never an implicit default. Requires preview_skipped_code. Collection-checked both ways: required on the direct jump, forbidden anywhere else. A prepared -> production jump skips staging too by definition, so staging_skipped is forbidden alongside it (one flag tells the whole story).

preview_skipped_code.description: Closed reason codes for skipping preview, same rationale as the bundle's omission codes: a production gate can allowlist codes, it cannot allowlist prose. Required exactly when preview_skipped is present.
